route_backbone: adaptive GFS/GEFS route: retain GFS/GEFS member route when it agrees with GEFS field mean, otherwise use GEFS field mean
structure_branch: Prediction-level ensemble of 3 v37G spatial field experts with current wind/pressure residual anchor
field_normalization: Training q/31.75; inference uses public-GFS SLP anomaly/tendency and weighted 850/500/200 u/v divided by the stored dlm4 scales
pressure_calibration: v37G validation-only pressure and wind consistency layers using current pressure/wind, recent tendencies, and predicted wind
data_policy: Local IBTrACS/JMA-derived track history plus cached public NOAA GFS fields; no CDS/API key

gfs_route_guide.policy: adaptive GFS/GEFS route: retain GFS/GEFS member route when it agrees with GEFS field mean, otherwise use GEFS field mean

gfs_route.policy: 50% deterministic GFS 850-hPa vortex track plus 50% GEFS multi-level vortex-track mean

gefs_mean_route.policy: GEFS ensemble-mean fields tracked independently at 850/500/200 hPa

v36_reference.input_note: Newest verified Dolphin observation with matching real GFS steering.
v36_reference.field_note: Pressure maps are parametric reconstructions from predicted center pressure, wind, RMW, and radii; they are not learned ERA5 grids.
